kept.q: Find the 9th term of the arithmetic progression: 7, 11, 15, 19, ...
kept.explanation: First term a=7, common difference d=4. The nth term is a+(n-1)d, so the 9th term = 7+8(4) = 7+32 = 39.
kept.pidgin: First term na 7, common difference na 4. Formula na a+(n-1)d, so 9th term = 7+8(4) = 39.

kept.q: A geometric progression has first term 3 and common ratio 2. Find the sum of the first 6 terms.
kept.explanation: Sum of first n terms of a GP is a(r^n - 1)/(r-1). Here Sn = 3(2^6 - 1)/(2-1) = 3(63)/1 = 189.
kept.pidgin: Sum formula na a(r^n - 1)/(r-1). So Sn = 3(2^6 -1)/(2-1) = 3 times 63 = 189.

kept.q: Chinedu starts saving money every month in an arithmetic progression. He saves ₦2000 in the first month and increases his savings by ₦500 every month after that. Find the total amount he has saved after 8 months.
The sum of the first 3 terms of a geometric progression is 7, and the sum of the first 6 terms is 63. Find the common ratio.
kept.explanation: Dividing S6 by S3 gives (r^3+1) because S6/S3 = (r^6-1)/(r^3-1) = r^3+1. So r^3+1 = 63/7 = 9, meaning r^3 = 8, so r = 2. Checking with a=1 confirms S3=7 and S6=63.
kept.pidgin: If you divide S6 by S3, you go get r^3+1, because S6/S3 = (r^6-1)/(r^3-1) = r^3+1. So r^3+1 = 63/7 = 9, meaning r^3 = 8, so r = 2. If you check am with a=1, e go confirm say S3=7 and S6=63.
